scenarios.title: Create a New Application List
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create a new application list with the expected mandatory information.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create a new application list so that applications can be managed for a specific sitting.
scenarios.preCondition: User is logged in with permission to create lists.

scenario.given: I am on the Applications List screen
scenario.when: I create a new list and complete all mandatory fields
and: I select either Court or CJA with Other Location in line with business rules
then: The list is saved successfully
The default status is "Open"
The list appears in search results

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with a Person Applicant (Fee Required, Respondent Required)
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create an Application List Entry with a person applicant using an application code where both respondent and fee are mandatory.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create an Application List Entry with a person applicant and respondent details so that the application is properly recorded with complete information.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists; application code selected requires respondent + fee.

scenario.given: I am creating a new Application List Entry
scenario.when: I select Person in the Applicant accordion
and: I populate mandatory applicant fields: First Forename, Surname, Address Line 1
I populate mandatory Respondent fields (Person or Organisation)
I populate Application Code, Wording, and Civil Fee details
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The applicant and respondent are saved
The Summary displays both applicant and respondent details
Both Applicant and Respondent accordions display saved details

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with a Person Applicant (Respondent Optional)
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create an Application List Entry with a person applicant using an application code where respondent is optional.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create an Application List Entry with a person applicant when respondent information is not required.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists; application code selected has respondent as optional.

scenario.given: I am creating a new Application List Entry
scenario.when: I select Person in the Applicant accordion and choose an app code with optional respondent
and: I populate mandatory applicant fields: First Forename, Surname, Address Line 1
I populate Application Code and Wording details
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The applicant is saved
Respondent section is empty or not displayed
The Summary shows applicant details only

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with an Organisation Applicant (Fee Required, Respondent Required)
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create an Application List Entry with an organisation applicant using an application code where both respondent and fee are mandatory.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create an Application List Entry with an organisation applicant and respondent details so that the application is recorded against the correct parties.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists; application code selected requires respondent + fee.

scenario.given: I have opened an Open Application List
scenario.when: I select Create Application
and: I choose Organisation in the Applicant accordion
I enter Organisation Name and Address Line 1
I complete mandatory Application Code, Wording, and Civil Fee information
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
Both applicant and respondent are saved as organisations
A success banner is displayed
The newly created entry displays both applicant and respondent in Summary and accordions

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with an Organisation Applicant (Respondent Optional)
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create an Application List Entry with an organisation applicant using an application code where respondent is optional.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to create an Application List Entry with an organisation applicant when respondent information is not required.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists; application code selected has respondent as optional.

scenario.given: I have opened an Open Application List
scenario.when: I select Create Application and choose an app code with optional respondent
and: I choose Organisation in the Applicant accordion
I enter Organisation Name and Address Line 1
I complete Application Code and Wording information
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The organisation applicant is saved
Respondent section remains empty
The newly created entry appears in the Application List

scenarios.title: Create a New Application List Entry with a Standard Applicant
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can create a new Application List Entry by selecting a Standard Applicant from lookup.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to select a Standard Applicant so that frequently used applicant details can be reused without re-keying.
scenarios.preCondition: Standard Applicants exist and are available through lookup.

scenario.given: I am creating a new Application List Entry
scenario.when: I select Standard Applicant in the Applicant accordion
and: I search for and select a valid Standard Applicant
I complete the mandatory Application Code and Wording information
then: The Application List Entry is created successfully
The Standard Applicant is linked to the entry
The selected Standard Applicant appears in the Summary
No Person or Organisation applicant details are submitted at the same time

scenarios.title: Invalid CSV Upload — Missing Required Fields
scenarios.summary: Confirm the system rejects CSV uploads where required columns or data are missing.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to know which required fields are missing so that I can correct the CSV before re-uploading.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists.

scenario.given: I have opened an Application List
scenario.when: I select Bulk Upload
and: I select a CSV file with missing required columns (e.g., missing Applicant First Forename, Surname, or Address Line 1)
then: The upload is rejected after file validation
An error message lists the missing required columns
Error details include row numbers where data is missing or incomplete
No entries are created
User is guided to update the CSV and resubmit

scenarios.title: Invalid CSV Upload — Incorrect File Format
scenarios.summary: Confirm the system rejects CSV files with incorrect format and displays an appropriate error message.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need clear feedback when an invalid file format is uploaded so that I can provide the correct file.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists.

scenario.given: I have opened an Application List
scenario.when: I select Bulk Upload
and: I select an invalid file format (e.g., .xlsx, .txt, .pdf instead of .csv)
then: The upload is rejected
An error message is displayed: 'Invalid file format. Please upload a CSV file.'
The upload does not proceed
The file input is cleared and ready for a new attempt
User can select a different file and retry

scenarios.title: Bulk Upload CSV
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can upload a valid CSV file to create multiple Application List Entries.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to upload a CSV of applications so that multiple Application List Entries can be created efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: An Open Application List exists.

scenario.given: I have opened an Application List
scenario.when: I select Bulk Upload
and: I choose a valid CSV file
then: The file is accepted
An upload in progress message is displayed
The upload job is created
The user receives a success or failure outcome
Successful entries appear in the Application List after completion

scenarios.title: Update Applicant Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update applicant details for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update applicant details so that data regarding the individual or organisation remains accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I expand the Applicant accordion
scenario.when: I change the applicant type or update applicant fields
then: The applicant is updated successfully
A success banner is displayed
The Summary reflects the updated applicant

scenarios.title: Update Application Wording
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update wording for an existing Application List Entry and validation behaves correctly.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update wording for an existing Application List Entry so that the application details remain correct.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry has an Application Code and wording.

scenario.given: I expand the Wording accordion
scenario.when: I update one or more wording fields
then: The wording is saved successfully
The Summary reflects the updated wording
The accordion stays open if validation errors occur
Server validation errors map to the correct fields

scenarios.title: Update Respondent Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update respondent details for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update respondent details so that the Application List Entry reflects the correct responding party.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I expand the Respondent accordion
scenario.when: I update the Person or Organisation respondent details
then: The respondent is updated successfully
Only one respondent type is active
The Summary reflects the updated respondent
Validation prevents save if required respondent fields are missing

scenarios.title: Update Civil Fee Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update Civil Fee details for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update fee details so that payment information remains accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry has Civil Fee data or a fee due Application Code.

scenario.given: I expand the Civil Fee accordion
scenario.when: I update Fee Status, Status Date, Payment Reference, Value or Off Site Fee
then: The fee details are updated successfully
The updated fee details display in the Civil Fee accordion
The Summary reflects the latest fee status
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Update Notes
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update notes and references for an existing Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update notes and references so that application context remains accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I am on an Application List Entry in update mode
scenario.when: I amend Application Notes, Case Reference or Account Reference
then: The changes are saved successfully
Cleared values are removed where expected
The updated values appear in the Notes accordion
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Bulk Update Notes
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update notes and references for multiple selected Application List Entries in one action.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to bulk update notes for multiple applications so that application context and references can be managed efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple Application List Entries are selected.

scenario.given: I have selected multiple Application List Entries
scenario.when: I select Bulk Update Notes
and: I update Application Notes, Case Reference and/or Account Reference
then: The notes are updated for all selected entries
A success banner displays the count of updated entries
Cleared values are removed where expected across all entries
The updated values appear in the Notes accordion of each entry
Return to Applications clears selections

scenarios.title: Bulk Update Officials
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update Magistrates and Court Official details for multiple selected Application List Entries in one action.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to bulk update officials for multiple applications so that officer and magistrate assignments can be managed efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple Application List Entries are selected.

scenario.given: I have selected multiple Application List Entries
scenario.when: I select Bulk Update Officials
and: I enter up to three Magistrates and one Court Official details
then: The officials are updated for all selected entries
A success banner displays the count of updated entries
The officials appear in the specified order
Validation prevents save if no surname is provided
Return to Applications clears selections

scenarios.title: Add Result Wording
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can apply result codes and wording to record an application outcome.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to apply result codes and wording so that the application outcome is recorded correctly.
scenarios.preCondition: An existing Application List Entry is open in update mode.

scenario.given: I am on an Application List Entry in update mode
scenario.when: I expand the Result Wording accordion
and: I search for a valid Result Code
I select and add the result
then: The result is saved successfully
The selected result appears in the result list
The Summary displays the result code and wording
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Add Officials
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can add Magistrates and Court Official details to an Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to record Magistrates and Court Official details so that applications can be audited and printed correctly.
scenarios.preCondition: User is creating an Application List Entry.

scenario.given: I open the Officials accordion
scenario.when: I enter up to three Magistrates and one Court Official
and: At least one surname is provided
then: The officials are saved successfully
The officials display in the order entered
The Summary and print view show the saved officials correctly

scenarios.title: Search, Filter & Sort Application List
scenarios.summary: Confirm search, filtering and sorting actions work together as expected for application results.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to search, filter and sort Application Lists so that I can efficiently find the applications I need to work with.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple Application Lists and entries exist with varied statuses, dates, and applicant types.

scenario.given: I am on the Application Lists screen with multiple results
scenario.when: I enter a search keyword (applicant name, application reference, etc.)
and: I apply one or more filters (e.g., Status = Open; Date = Last 7 days)
The results are filtered to match my criteria
I click a column header to sort results (e.g., by Created Date, Applicant Name)
then: Search results accurately match the keyword
Filtered results show only matching entries
Sorted results display in correct order
Page numbers and total count reflect filtered and sorted results
Filters and sort remain active if I navigate away and return

scenarios.title: Print One Entry — Positive Path
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can print one selected Application List Entry with complete valid data.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to view and print one Application List Entry so that I can generate a record for audit or filing.
scenarios.preCondition: A valid Application List Entry with complete applicant, respondent, fee, officials and result data exists and is selected.

scenario.given: I have selected one Application List Entry with complete data
scenario.when: I select Print
and: All mandatory data is present: applicant, wording, civil fee (if required), officials, results (if applicable)
then: The print job is sent successfully
The printed output displays all sections correctly
Officials appear in the order entered
Fee details display accurately
Result codes and wording appear on print

scenarios.title: Print One Entry — Negative Path (Missing Data)
scenarios.summary: Confirm the system prevents printing an entry with missing mandatory data and displays appropriate error messages.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need clear validation messages when print data is incomplete so I can correct issues before printing.
scenarios.preCondition: An Application List Entry with missing mandatory fields (e.g., no respondent when required; no fee details) is selected.

scenario.given: I have selected an Application List Entry with incomplete data
scenario.when: I select Print
and: Mandatory fields are missing or invalid
then: Validation error messages are displayed
The error messages identify missing fields
Print action is prevented
User is guided to complete missing data before retrying

scenarios.title: Print Continuation One Entry — Positive Path
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can review and complete the print flow for one entry with all sections confirmed.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to review and confirm print details before finalizing so that the correct output is generated.
scenarios.preCondition: Print preview is open with complete valid data.

scenario.given: I am on the print confirmation screen for one entry
scenario.when: I review all sections (applicant, respondent, fees, officials, results)
and: I select Confirm Print or Continue
then: The print flow completes successfully
The print job is processed
A success message is displayed
I am returned to the Application List

scenarios.title: Print Continuation One Entry — Negative Path (Invalid Data)
scenarios.summary: Confirm the system prevents print continuation when invalid or corrupted data is detected.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to be alerted to data integrity issues so I can resolve them before printing.
scenarios.preCondition: Print preview displays data validation errors (e.g., fee value exceeds allowed range; invalid date format in officials).

scenario.given: I am on the print confirmation screen
scenario.when: The system detects invalid or corrupted data during validation
then: Print continuation is blocked
User is guided to correct the data in the main entry
Print flow is cancelled or reset
User must return to the entry, fix issues, and retry print

scenarios.title: Print Select All — Positive Path
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can print all selected Application List Entries with complete valid data.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to print multiple Application List Entries in one action so that I can generate batch records efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple Application List Entries with complete valid data are selected.

scenario.given: I have selected multiple Application List Entries, all with complete data
scenario.when: I select Print All
and: All entries pass validation (complete applicant, wording, fees, officials, results as applicable)
The print preview displays all entries
then: All selected entries print successfully
Each entry prints with all sections correctly displayed
Print job processes without errors
A success message shows count of printed entries

scenarios.title: Print Select All — Negative Path (Mixed Valid/Invalid)
scenarios.summary: Confirm the system handles a selection where some entries are valid and others have missing data.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to know which entries cannot be printed so I can complete them before retrying the batch action.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple entries are selected; some are complete and valid, others have missing mandatory data.

scenario.given: I have selected multiple Application List Entries with mixed completeness
scenario.when: I select Print All
and: Some entries fail validation (missing respondent, incomplete fee details, etc.)
then: Validation prevents the batch print from proceeding
Error message lists which entries failed and why
User is prompted to fix the incomplete entries
A link or action allows user to view and edit the problematic entries
Print action can be retried once issues are corrected

scenarios.title: Print Continuation Select All — Positive Path
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can review and complete the print flow for all selected entries.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to confirm all entries are correct before committing the batch print.
scenarios.preCondition: Print preview for multiple entries is open with all data valid.

scenario.given: I am on the print confirmation screen showing all selected entries
scenario.when: I review the entry summary
and: All entries display with correct data
then: All entries print successfully
A completion message confirms count of entries printed
Return to Application List clears selections and displays fresh list

scenarios.title: Print Continuation Select All — Negative Path (Post-Validation Failure)
scenarios.summary: Confirm the system handles validation failures detected during print continuation for batch operations.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to be informed if an entry becomes invalid between preview and print so I can take corrective action.
scenarios.preCondition: Print preview is displayed; before confirmation, one or more entries is modified externally or data integrity issue is detected.

scenario.given: I am on the print confirmation screen for multiple entries
scenario.when: I attempt to Confirm Print
and: The system re-validates entries before committing
One or more entries fail validation (data modified, fee recalculated, etc.)
then: Print is prevented
An error message identifies which entries failed and why
User is offered options: (a) Print only valid entries, (b) Cancel and fix, (c) Return to edit affected entries
Upon selection, action is taken accordingly

scenarios.title: Move Applications
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can move one or more Application List Entries to another Application List.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to move one or more Application List Entries to another list so that workload can be managed flexibly.
scenarios.preCondition: One or more eligible Application List Entries are selected.

scenario.given: I have selected one or more Application List Entries
scenario.when: I select Move Applications
and: I choose a target Application List, using the create an Application List steps from UAT 1 where needed
I review the Check your answers page
then: The selected applications are moved successfully
A success banner is displayed
The applications appear on the target list
The applications are no longer shown on the original list where applicable
Return to Applications takes me back with selections cleared

scenarios.title: Bulk Update Fee Details
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can update fee details for multiple selected Application List Entries.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to update fee details for multiple applications so that payment status can be managed efficiently.
scenarios.preCondition: Multiple Application List Entries are selected and they all require a fee.

scenario.given: I have selected multiple Application List Entries
scenario.when: I select Update Fee Details
and: I enter Fee Status, Status Date, Payment Reference and Off Site Fee where required
then: The fee update is applied to the selected entries
A success banner is displayed
Validation prevents invalid fee status or date values
Return to Applications clears the selections

scenarios.title: Remove a Result
scenarios.summary: Confirm a user can remove an incorrect result from an Application List Entry.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need to remove an incorrect result so that the application outcome is accurate.
scenarios.preCondition: An Application List Entry has at least one result recorded.

scenario.given: I expand the Result Wording accordion
scenario.when: I remove an existing result
then: The result is removed successfully
The result no longer appears in the Result Wording section
The Summary is updated
A success banner is displayed

scenarios.title: Result Selected with Select All
scenarios.summary: Confirm Select All represents all matching applications when applying result actions across a result set.
scenarios.businessGoal: As a court user, I need Select All to represent all matching applications so that I understand the scope of the result action.
scenarios.preCondition: Search results span more than one page.

scenario.given: I select all applications across the current result set
scenario.when: I open the Result Selected screen
then: The screen clearly indicates that all matching applications are selected
The table is replaced with an All summary where appropriate
The save action applies to the intended selected set
The selection scope is not confused with only the current page
